name: Deskfirst
description:
Deskfirst turns scattered files and email threads into a single branded portal you share with a customer. Agencies, consultants, freelancers, and sales teams use it for proposals, onboarding, project handoffs, and ongoing account work — anywhere someone needs one link instead of ten attachments.

With this connector, Claude can create a portal for a new customer or project, organize files and folders inside it, apply your branding, and generate a share link or invite people directly. Start from a reusable template or your content library so every portal opens fully populated.

Claude can also build and maintain Mutual Action Plans: create sections and tasks, assign owners and due dates, attach files, and post comments as work progresses.

The read side is where it earns its place day to day. Ask which customers visited this week, which files they opened and for how long, or which projects have gone quiet — Deskfirst surfaces engagement signals per file and per person, and rolls them up across accounts and team members.

Typical uses: stand up a customer portal the moment a project or deal starts, prep for a call by asking what they've actually been reading, keep an action plan current without switching tabs, and spot stalled work before it surprises you.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Deskfirst to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Deskfirst to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.deskfirst.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Deskfirst MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deskfirst lists 65 MCP tools, including add_comment, add_dock_button, add_file_tag, add_map_task_attachment, add_map_task_comment, clone_desktop, create_content_library, create_desktop, create_desktop_template, create_folder, create_integration, and create_map.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Deskfirst?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Deskfirst in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Deskfirst requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Deskfirst is developed by Deskfirst, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
